marks_reason_check.name: marks_reason_check
marks_reason_check.value: "marks"."reason" IS NULL OR "marks"."corrects_mark_id" IS NOT NULL

marks_office_correction_check.name: marks_office_correction_check
marks_office_correction_check.value: "marks"."driver_id" IS NOT NULL OR "marks"."reason" IS NOT NULL

marks_location_check.name: marks_location_check
marks_location_check.value:
("marks"."latitude" IS NULL AND "marks"."longitude" IS NULL)
      OR ("marks"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "marks"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

marks_receiver_kind_check.name: marks_receiver_kind_check
marks_receiver_kind_check.value:
"marks"."receiver_kind" IS NULL
      OR ("marks"."receiver_kind" = 'authorized_adult' AND "marks"."receiver_adult_id" IS NOT NULL AND "marks"."receiver_destination_id" IS NULL
        AND "marks"."receiver_name" IS NULL AND "marks"."receiver_dni" IS NULL AND "marks"."authorization_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("marks"."receiver_kind" = 'destination' AND "marks"."receiver_destination_id" IS NOT NULL AND "marks"."receiver_adult_id" IS NULL
        AND "marks"."receiver_name" IS NULL AND "marks"."receiver_dni" IS NULL AND "marks"."authorization_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("marks"."receiver_kind" = 'other_adult' AND "marks"."receiver_name" IS NOT NULL AND "marks"."receiver_dni" IS NOT NULL
        AND "marks"."receiver_adult_id" IS NULL AND "marks"."receiver_destination_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("marks"."receiver_kind" = 'base_staff' AND "marks"."receiver_adult_id" IS NULL AND "marks"."receiver_destination_id" IS NULL
        AND "marks"."receiver_name" IS NULL AND "marks"."receiver_dni" IS NULL AND "marks"."authorization_id" IS NULL)

routes_start_point_check.name: routes_start_point_check
routes_start_point_check.value:
("routes"."start_kind" = 'point' AND "routes"."start_latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "routes"."start_longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)
      OR ("routes"."start_kind" IS DISTINCT FROM 'point' AND "routes"."start_latitude" IS NULL AND "routes"."start_longitude" IS NULL)

transfers_exit_time_check.name: transfers_exit_time_check
transfers_exit_time_check.value: "transfers"."exit_time" IS NULL OR ("transfers"."origin_destination_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transfers"."exit_time" < "transfers"."target_time")
